description: This file defines an immutable Java class named ImmutableSubjectId implementing the SubjectId interface. It provides static factory methods to create instances based on issuer and subject strings, and includes logic for parsing such identifiers from strings. The class encapsulates the concept of a subject identifier with an issuer and subject component, featuring validation and standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectId
classes.description: An immutable implementation of SubjectId, representing a subject identifier with an issuer and subject component, providing validation and string parsing capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a SubjectId from issuer and subject components, validating inputs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a SubjectId from a combined string, parsing issuer and subject parts, with special handling for placeholders and delimiter logic.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer component of this SubjectId.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject component of this SubjectId.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation of this SubjectId.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation, combining issuer and subject with a delimiter if issuer is non-empty.
